WEBVTT

00:00:04.000 --> 00:00:09.000
<v Priya Shah>Let's start with the CSV export bug. Where are we?</v>

00:00:09.500 --> 00:00:15.000
<v Marcus Webb>I'll fix the CSV export bug by Thursday, I found the root cause already.</v>

00:00:15.500 --> 00:00:20.000
<v Priya Shah>Great. And I think we agreed v1 ships CSV only, not Excel, right?</v>

00:00:20.500 --> 00:00:26.000
<v Marcus Webb>Yes, that's locked in. Excel export is out of scope for v1.</v>

00:00:26.500 --> 00:00:33.000
<v Priya Shah>Perfect. Sofia, can you update the onboarding doc with the new login flow?</v>

00:00:33.500 --> 00:00:38.000
<v Sofia Nakamura>Sure, I'll update the onboarding doc today.</v>

00:00:38.500 --> 00:00:44.000
<v Priya Shah>Anything else? ... No? Ok let's wrap up.</v>
